python3 -c "
from defusedxml.minidom import parse
doc = parse('unpacked/word/document.xml')
body = doc.getElementsByTagName('w:body')[0]
for i, p in enumerate(body.getElementsByTagName('w:p')):
    texts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName('w:t'):
        if t.firstChild:
            texts.append(t.firstChild.data)
    text = ''.join(texts)
    # get style
    pPr = p.getElementsByTagName('w:pPr')
    style = ''
    if pPr:
        ps = pPr[0].getElementsByTagName('w:pStyle')
        if ps:
            style = ps[0].getAttribute('w:val')
    print(f'[{i}] style={style!r} text={text!r}')
"
